summary:
Wales's devolved administration publicly maintains an LGBTQ+ Action Plan with a standing update page issued after the For Women Scotland judgment (19 December 2025), and has enacted statutory school guidance ("Rights, Respect, Equality," consultation May 2025) obliging schools to challenge bullying and harassment on gender-reassignment grounds with recording and monitoring, alongside a dedicated national guidance for supporting trans children in development through 2025–26. These measures represent an active state posture of inclusion at a time when the UK-wide EHRC single-sex-services code (in force 5 August 2026) creates a biological-sex facility-exclusion floor identical in Wales to England.

For a visitor the practical risk of service refusal is unchanged — the code binds Welsh facilities as equally as English ones — but the visible institutional commitment (Action Plan maintained, school recording obligations, FOI-disclosed guidance work) shapes policing culture and public discourse. Score sits +0.03 above the national anchor: Wales is not materially safer on facilities, but it is the only devolved administration actively counter-signalling the national climate with published protection programmes. Above England, which has no equivalent positive devolved signal.

sources.summary: Welsh Government LGBTQ+ Action Plan document for young people (posted January 2026): part of the standing devolved inclusion programme whose update page answers the For Women Scotland judgment of 19 December 2025.

Welsh Government statutory school guidance "Rights, Respect, Equality" (consultation May 2025): obliges schools to challenge bullying and harassment on sex, gender-reassignment and sexual-orientation grounds, with incident recording/monitoring and a parental escalation route.
Wales Centre for Public Policy rapid evidence review commissioned to inform the separate national guidance on schools supporting trans children and young people, developed through 2025-26.
Welsh Government transparency release (ATISN 26923): FOI-disclosed correspondence evidencing the trans-children school-guidance consultation work.

localsOnly: The school guidance, young-people action-plan material and recording duties bear on resident families and pupils; for a short-term visitor they register only as a protective institutional climate.
